Panzer.et:
From Middle High German panzer, panzier, from Old French panciere (“coat of mail to protect the belly”), from pance (“paunch, belly”) (compare Medieval Latin panceria, pancerium), from Latin pantex (“paunch, belly”).
See also Pansen.

s: Panzerfaust (type of anti-tank grenade launcher developed in WWII, now usually the Panzerfaust 3)
bazooka, any shoulder-fired anti-tank grenade launcher

Als normales Product unseres staatlichen Unterrichts verließ ich Ostern 1832 die Schule als Pantheist, und wenn nicht als Republikaner, doch mit der Ueberzeugung, daß die Republik die vernünftigste Staatsform sei, [...]

I left school at Easter 1832, a normal product of our state system of education; a Pantheist, and, if not a Republican, at least with the persuation that the Republic was the most rational form of government; …

Perfect cognate with Dutch pantoffel.

s: panther, black panther (a leopard or other big cat with black fur)
a big cat of the genus Panthera
Panther.et: From Middle High German panter, pantel, from Latin panthera, from Ancient Greek πάνθηρ (pánthēr).

Pandemie.et: From Ancient Greek πανδημία (pandēmía, “all the people”)

pantomime (type of entertainment where players act out ideas without use of their voice)
a unicellular ciliate protozoan of the Paramecium genus, first described by Antoni van Leeuwenhoek.
Pantoffeltierchen.et:
From Pantoffel + Tier + -chen.
Likely a calque of Dutch pantoffeldiertje.

s: Panzer, a tank, armoured fighting vehicle
Panzerkampfwagen.et: From Panzer + Kampf + Wagen, which can be translated altogether as "armored combat vehicle".

panel, panelling (decorative, typically wooden# slats covering interior walls or ceilings)
Paneel.et: From Middle Low German panēl, probably through Middle Dutch paneel eventually from Old French panel, from Vulgar Latin *pannellus. Doublet of Panel.

Der passendste Name wird für seine Lehre Panlogismus seyn.

Soll er seine Pandekten büffeln und die Schnauze halten. Auf seine schöngeistigen Schmöker huste ich!
cupola (rotatable, armed and armored dome; also on terrain but especially on tanks and warships)
life changes (used to emphasize that things are constantly changing in life and nothing stays the same)
panta rhei.et: Unadapted borrowing from Ancient Greek πάντα ῥεῖ (pánta rheî, “everything flows”), coined by Ancient Greek philosopher Heraclitus.

s: Punjab (a geographical region in South Asia, politically divided between India and Pakistan)
a soldier in the mechanized infantry (footsoldiers using infantry fighting vehicles)

Panzertape.et: From Panzer (“tank, armor”) + Tape, the first part typically seen as either referring to the high degree of sturdiness or originating from usage in the military. Entered wider usage in the 2000s.

s: panresistant (a microorganism showing resistance to all available antibiotics)
mule (shoe with an upper covering but without a back flap or strap, leaving the heel exposed)
Ein junger Mann mit schwarzem Kapuzenpullover, beiger Schlabberhose und Socken in Pantoletten steht in dieser leicht beißenden Geruchsschwade und spielt Fußball.
A young man wearing a black hoodie, beige baggy pants and socks in mules is standing in this slightly pungent odour and playing soccer.
lover, flame (romantic partner or lover); affair (of a married person)
panic selling, panic sale (the hasty sale of securities out of fear of substantial further losses)
Aus Angst vor weiteren Kursverlusten kam es zu zahlreichen Panikverkäufen.
Fear of further price declines led to widespread panic selling.
Anleger sollten vermeiden, bei starken Kursschwankungen aus Angst einen Panikverkauf zu tätigen.
Investors should avoid making a panic sale out of fear during sharp market fluctuations.
panic buying, panic purchase (a hasty purchase of everyday goods, especially in unusually large quantities, out of fear that they may soon become scarce or unavailable)
Aus Sorge vor Lieferengpässen kam es in vielen Supermärkten zu Panikkäufen von haltbaren Lebensmitteln und Toilettenpapier.
Concern about supply shortages led to panic buying of nonperishable food and toilet paper in many supermarkets.
Die Behörden warnten vor Panikkäufen und betonten, dass die Versorgung mit Lebensmitteln gesichert sei.
The authorities warned against panic buying and stressed that the food supply was secure.
